prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one reusable fictional character identity reference for four short films, not a scene from a film.
Primary request: Create a single high-quality full-body reference portrait of Harry Potter in a young-adult alternate universe. Use an original face interpretation rather than deliberately reproducing a particular film actor.
Subject: A man in his early twenties with a lean build, light skin, a soft oval face, short untidy black hair, plain round black glasses and a small subtle forehead scar. He has an attentive, relaxed expression with a hint of quiet good humor.
Clothing: Simple practical charcoal long-sleeved top with one broad muted-red chest panel, charcoal trousers and plain dark flat boots. Natural fabric texture, no crest or decorative costume.
Composition: Exactly one person, standing in a relaxed balanced pose, arms comfortably at his sides, both hands and all shoes visible. Almost frontal body with a slight three-quarter head turn toward the camera. Clear unobstructed face, glasses and hair silhouette, realistic proportions, no cropped limbs. Portrait-oriented frame with a little clear space around him.
Scene and lighting: Plain light warm-gray studio background and floor, soft even neutral daylight, gentle grounding shadow, crisp natural facial and hair detail. Photographic character-reference finish, restrained color and realistic skin texture.
Constraints: No other people, duplicate views, inset heads, captions, text, logos, watermark, wand, broom, book, furniture or magical effects. This is a visual identity reference, not an anatomical measurement or a claim of calibrated geometry.
